context: 1490.74 points got scored across the league this week, 124.23 per team -- make of that what you will.

awards.name: Best Bench
awards.text: Nobody stranded more points on the bench than Jake From State Farm (77.96), headlined by Fernando Mendoza's 27.88-point no-show in the starting lineup.

awards.name: You Didn't Lose!
awards.text: Newman’s Owen scored just 118.94 -- the 7th-highest score in the league this week -- but theMadgician somehow scored even less (97.76), so the win counts all the same.

awards.name: Great Defense!
awards.text: Tanner Time put up 81.7 -- the 12th-worst week anyone had -- and Supernovas happily took the free win.

awards.name: Mega Blowout
awards.text: Supernovas demolished Tanner Time 161.76-81.7, a 80.06-point margin -- the biggest blowout of the week.
